entries.description: KnownGate is the food verification layer for people's agents: it checks food against a stated premise and returns evidence-backed verdicts with sources and read dates. Four verdicts; two are honest ways of saying we don't know; the word safe never appears.
representativeQueries: is this cereal under 10 grams of sugar per serving
which items on the Krystal menu are free of sesame
check this shopping list against my family's allergies
verify this recipe against a dairy-free household

metadata.authentication: Free key, 100 checks a month, from POST /api/knowngate/v0/keys or the register tool. Checking on knowngate.com itself never needs a key.
